scope: Independent static review of the exact 0.2.525 primary-item Store ZIP for Blue Argon remotely hosted code

rejection_specific_policy.prior_rejection_reference: Blue Argon, routing ID FZSL; the October 11 rejection identified https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdfobject/2.1.1/pdfobject.min.js in a bundled jsPDF chunk
rejection_specific_policy.exact_zip_findings: No cdnjs.cloudflare.com string or rejected PDFObject URL appears in the 1,241 emitted JavaScript and HTML files. The remaining PDFObject strings in chunks/pdf-BIJOqcW6.js are jsPDF API identifiers; the PDF viewer branches throw that remote PDF viewers are unavailable. No executable script element with a src assignment and appendChild, importScripts call, or HTTP(S) JavaScript/MJS loader URL was found.
rejection_specific_policy.scan_scope: Every emitted .js and .html asset in the exact Store ZIP. The script-loader detector mirrors scripts/detect-remote-script-loader.mjs; prohibited runtime tokens mirror scripts/check-cws-release-risk.mjs. CDN/PDFObject and remote script-like URL scans were also run. This is bounded static evidence, not proof of runtime behavior for every possible input.

integrity_and_baseline.manifest_policy_fields: All policy fields selected by scripts/check-cws-release-risk.mjs match config/chrome-web-store-approved-baseline.json. The ZIP manifest includes action.default_icon paths; the approved policy surface and release gate intentionally compare only action.default_title.
integrity_and_baseline.hosted_release_evidence: The exact run log records Chrome Web Store package validation passed and the approval-risk gate passed against the 0.2.205 policy baseline. It also records 357 test files and 2,490 tests passed and migration-ledger verification.

limits: This review inspected the exact Store ZIP statically; it did not exercise the extension in a browser or inspect the Store dashboard.

This package verdict establishes that the identified October 11 remote PDFObject loader is absent from the inspected emitted assets; it does not establish upload, submission, current review state, or Store acceptance.
No claim is made about a new publisher email or the status of any submission.

verification_method: Fetched the immutable GitHub Actions artifact and verified its SHA-256 against GitHub artifact metadata; verified the inner Store ZIP SHA-256 against the release receipt; checked the tag target and source ancestry; parsed the exact ZIP manifest and compared its release-gate policy projection with the approved baseline; scanned every emitted JavaScript and HTML asset for the rejected URL, PDFObject/cdnjs references, remote script URLs, injected script loaders, importScripts, and prohibited runtime-code tokens; reviewed the exact hosted release log for package/risk gate results.
